# StatusIcon

<!-- description:start -->
Displays the icon for a Tracker issue status. Each status type maps to a distinct SVG icon and color. Unknown status keys fall back to a question-mark icon.
<!-- description:end -->

## Usage

```tsx
import {StatusIcon} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

<StatusIcon statusType="inProgress" />
```

## Component props

<!-- props:start -->
```ts
{
    /**
     * Status type/key from the Tracker API. Accepts `IssueStatus` values.
     * Unknown values fall back to a question-mark icon.
     */
    statusType?:
        | 'new'
        | 'inProgress'
        | 'paused'
        | 'done'
        | 'cancelled'
        | 'unknown'
        | string;

    /**
     * Size of the icon in pixels.
     * @default 16
     */
    size?: number;

    /**
     * Additional CSS class applied to the icon element.
     */
    className?: string;

    /**
     * Additional CSS class applied to the outer container element.
     */
    containerClassName?: string;

    /**
     * Human-readable status name (e.g. `"In progress"`, `"Done"`).
     * When provided, an accessible label `"Status: <title>"` is rendered for
     * screen readers. When omitted, the icon is treated as decorative (`aria-hidden`).
     */
    title?: string;
}
```
<!-- props:end -->

---

## Examples

### Single icon

```tsx
import {StatusIcon} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

<StatusIcon statusType="new" />
<StatusIcon statusType="inProgress" />
<StatusIcon statusType="done" />
```

### Custom size

```tsx
<StatusIcon statusType="inProgress" size={24} />
<StatusIcon statusType="inProgress" size={32} />
```

### Alongside issue summary

```tsx
import {StatusIcon} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

export const IssueRow = ({issue}: {issue: {statusType: string; summary: string}}) => (
    <div style={{display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8}}>
        <StatusIcon statusType={issue.statusType} size={16} />
        <span>{issue.summary}</span>
    </div>
);
```

### From Tracker API — issue status

Requires the `"tracker:issues:read"` permission in your plugin's `manifest.json`:

```json
{
    "permissions": {
        "data": ["tracker:issues:read"]
    }
}
```

```tsx
import {StatusIcon} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

const status = await trackerApi.v3.get['/issues/{id}/{field}']({
    pathParams: {
        id: 'ISSUEKEY-1',
        field: 'status',
    },
});

<StatusIcon
    statusType={status.data.key}
    title={status.data.display}
/>
```

---

## Notes

- The `statusType` value is matched case-sensitively. Values returned by the Tracker API match directly without transformation.
- Passing an unknown string does not throw — the component renders a question-mark fallback icon.
- When `title` is omitted the icon is treated as decorative and gets `aria-hidden="true"`. Pass `title` (e.g. `status.display` from the API) to make the icon accessible.
- The component accepts the `IssueStatus` type union (issue statuses), which is exported from the package.
